what: Plan §6.3 calibration row: a 12 m/s wheel strike on a barrier's end sends that wheel loose (P1-S04a). The car runs +x at 12 m/s, lined up so its left front wheel meets the end face of a 0.9 m barrier (the body's side is clear of it). The wheel collider (a part of its own, excluded from the terrain) registers the strike; only that wheel loses health.
